title: Machine Learning Models for Predicting the Risk of Hard-to-Heal Diabetic Foot Ulcers in a Chinese Population.
summary: A naive Bayes model predicted hard-to-heal diabetic-foot ulcers among 362 patients in a two-center dataset, with AUC 0.864 and 0.907 recall. The model uses a held-out split and an online calculator; clinical impact remains untested.
